metadataDraft.name: AssetRounds
metadataDraft.subtitle: 標牌檢查與現場記錄
metadataDraft.promotionalText: 記錄標牌觀察、照片與已執行的工作。保留本機歷程，準備可分享的 PDF 報告。
metadataDraft.description:
AssetRounds 協助您記錄標牌檢查。儲存可見狀況的觀察、備註、照片與工作記錄。檢視歷程、進行複查，並準備 PDF 報告。

記錄保留在此裝置上。分享報告會開啟系統選項，不表示已完成交付。觀察記錄不是認證、診斷或合規判定。

此內容為待審閱草稿。發布前須依最終版本確認可用功能與語言。
metadataDraft.keywords: 標牌,檢查,照片,證據,報告,巡檢,工作

reviewRequirements: Professional Traditional Chinese translator and independent native review directly against the English source
Bilingual U.S. sign-workflow review; no acceptance by mechanically converting Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese keyboard marked-text composition, candidate selection and no forced spaces
Compact labels, punctuation, largest Dynamic Type, VoiceOver pronunciation and focus order
Font licensing/coverage, PDF shaping/extraction on Letter/A4, physical printing
Reconcile after S; shared catalog integration only through P04-C07

sourceDefects.sourceIssue: Existing English catalog and English registry default contain a literal truncated Swift fragment instead of the original fallback/action label.
sourceDefects.disposition: Traditional Chinese draft uses baseline-proven label; inherited English bytes unchanged. Shared English catalog repair belongs to P04-C07; English default registry outside that fence requires the applicable causal-owner correction/reconciliation authority. No final acceptance until resolved.
